description.vi: Soot mở và dùng trang web trong một trình duyệt riêng cho từng cuộc trò chuyện (hoặc một trình duyệt giữ đăng nhập cho Soot được chủ máy chọn); bạn xem và điều khiển cùng lúc.
description.en: The Soot opens and uses websites in a browser kept per conversation (or one signed-in browser kept for a Soot the host names); you watch and take over live.

tools.name: control
tools.description: Control a browser with agent-browser: Chromium by default, CloakBrowser on request (engine). Read browser-use skill first. The host supplies the session: one per conversation, or one kept for the Soot when the host lists it in SOOT_BROWSER_PERSISTENT_SOOTS; never choose a session or a path. profile works in a named sign-in a person granted this Soot (Nest › Cài đặt › Trình duyệt); the conversation then stays in it until close. A task bound to a profile always works in that one (profile is then optional and must match), close included, and a profile with a proxy only ever opens through it. command runs one agent-browser command (args), or several in one call (steps). upload sends one workspace file to a page's file input. screenshot saves a PNG of the current tab (at 2x CSS pixels) to a workspace path and shows it to you in its result, scaled to fit (url opens a page first). close ends the browser (sign-ins stay); do it when you are done unless the person is using it.

steps.description: command: several commands run in order in one call, in place of args, e.g. [["fill","@e2","Lan"],["check","@e6"],["click","@e9"]]. It stops at the first that fails and says which; the ones before it stay applied. A step ["screenshot","tmp/f1.png"] (add "--full" for the whole page) saves a frame and shows it in the result, up to 4 a call: open, wait, screenshot, eval the next state, screenshot. A step ["resize","900","700"] changes the viewport between frames.

url.description: navigate and tab_new: the page to open. screenshot: open this page first, then capture it, in one call.

delta_x.description: Optional precise wheel delta in pixels; preserves legacy direction when omitted.

delta_y.description: Optional precise wheel delta in pixels; preserves legacy direction when omitted.

selector.description: upload: the file input (a ref like @e12 or a CSS selector).

path.description: upload: a workspace-relative media file (mp4, mov, m4v, jpg, jpeg, png, webp; at most 512 MiB). screenshot: the workspace-relative .png to write (missing folders are made). Absolute, hidden and symlinked paths are refused.

sha256.description: upload (required): the file's sha256 from the claim; a changed file is refused.

profile.description: Optional: a named browser profile id the host granted this Soot (its sign-ins). Omit to use the conversation's own browser. A profile not granted is refused before anything runs.

full_page.description: screenshot: capture the whole page, not just the viewport.

engine.description: The browser to run on. chromium (the default) is current Chrome for Testing. cloak is CloakBrowser, a Chromium that hides automation: use it only when the person asks for it or a site blocks the normal browser and the person agrees. Switching closes the browser (the tabs are lost) and reopens it. Sign-in profiles always run on cloak.

tools.name: view
tools.description: Inspect conversation browser availability without launching it; profiles lists the named browser profiles the host granted this Soot; in a bound task it shows that profile's browser. Nest subscribes to its live screencast.

tools.name: chromium_check
tools.description: Report whether the browser (soot-browser and Chromium) is installed on the Soot host, as JSON {installed, version, supported, path}. Never downloads or launches it.

tools.name: chromium_install
tools.description: Download the checksum-pinned soot-browser and Chromium (about 170 MB) into the Soot home, then report the same JSON as chromium_check. Operator action from Nest Programs; never retried automatically.

FILE_ROOT.title: Thư mục làm việc
FILE_ROOT.description: Thư mục làm việc của cuộc trò chuyện; chỉ dùng cho thao tác tải tệp (upload) lên trang. Nest cấp tự động; trình duyệt chỉ tải tệp nằm trong thư mục này.
